Adult male with natural short tousled dark brown hair, subtle stubble and a clearly modeled expressive face, focused forward. Correct modest human head size, face visible in three-quarter profile. A tailored mustard heavyweight cotton hoodie with real gravity folds and set-in shoulders, indigo denim with convincing knees/seat, fitted dark riding gloves and premium low-top grey sneakers. concepts.name: 03-race-rookie

Athletic adult with correct human anatomy, believable restrained blue/white technical jersey and articulated race pants, technical stretch panels and smooth sewn transitions, detailed tall motocross/trials boots with molded shin plates, ankle flex, subtle compact buckles and correct sole contact.
